owner_objective: Make a real Bright Data self-healing loop produce title, price, and availability in post-heal structured output, then let deterministic AEGIS verification and risk decide.
non_fabrication_policy: No fabricated provider output, candidate, verification, post-heal success, or REAL_PROVIDER label.
No historical Mission 033/041 evidence modification or hash rewriting.
No undocumented endpoint or hidden retry.
provider_experiment_policy: A bounded real provider experiment may be executed only after local simulation passes and a fresh immutable experiment record defines collector, target, explicit version, exact operation budget, prompt hash, correlation ID, raw-first evidence paths, and stop conditions.
approval_boundary: A real approval requires separate explicit authorization after a complete candidate is locally verified.
rerun_boundary: A real post-heal rerun requires separate explicit authorization after approval and provider completion.
commit_boundary: Production commit and downstream shipment remain owner-controlled; neither is authorized by this record.
